affine schemes Spec(B), Spec(A) and Spec(C)

items.review_rationale: Read the entire scheme fibre-product universal property with morphisms over S, the scheme object, commuting projections and the unique compatible mediating morphism. Distinguished scheme pullback from merely set-theoretic products.

references.phrase: universal property of scheme fibre product
commuting projection arrows X×_S Y→X and X×_S Y→Y

items.review_rationale: Reviewed the finite-projective module map, its prime-indexed residue-field fibres, the induced tensor-extended linear map and ordinary injectivity. Universal/pure injectivity is expressly not substituted.

residue field κ(p) of the local ring at prime p

references.context: Induced κ(p)-linear map φ⊗id_{κ(p)} from tensoring a map of finite projective R-modules with the residue field
Ordinary injectivity, equivalently zero kernel, of the induced vector-space map; not universally injective or pure module map

items.review_rationale: Read the full surjectivity locus condition at all prime localizations and separated it from the additional theorem about openness under the source section's hypotheses. Did not substitute fibrewise surjectivity without justification.
